title: Search Agents
content: List Agents available in this service.

title: Get Agent
content: Get an agent by ID.

title: Get Agent Schemas
content: Get an agent's schemas by ID.

title: Create Thread
content: Create a thread.

title: Search Threads
content:
Search for threads.

This endpoint also functions as the endpoint to list all threads.

title: Get Thread History
content: Get all past states for a thread.

title: Copy Thread
content: Create a new thread with a copy of the state and checkpoints from an existing thread.

title: Get Thread
content: Get a thread by ID.

title: Delete Thread
content: Delete a thread by ID.

title: Patch Thread
content: Update a thread.

title: Search Runs
content: List runs for a thread, agent or status

title: Get Run
content: Get a run by ID.

title: Delete Run
content: Delete a run by ID.

title: Wait for Run output
content: Wait for a run to finish, return the final output. If the run already finished, returns its final output immediately.

title: Stream output from Run
content: Join the output stream of an existing run. This endpoint streams output in real-time from a run similar to the /threads/__THREAD_ID__/runs/stream endpoint. Only output produced after this endpoint is

title: Create Background Run
content: Create a run in a new thread, return the run ID immediately. Don't wait for the final run output.

title: Create Run, Stream Output
content: Create a run in a new thread, stream the output.

title: Create Run, Wait for Output
content: Create a run in a new thread. Wait for the final output and then return it.

title: Open Thread WebSocket Stream
content: Upgrade to a WebSocket connection for a thread. After the connection is upgraded, clients send streaming protocol commands in-band and receive command responses plus unsolicited events on the same con

title: Open Thread SSE Stream
content: Open a connection-scoped Server-Sent Events stream for a thread. The request body selects channels, namespace prefixes, optional namespace depth, and an optional sequence number to replay buffered eve

title: Send Thread Streaming Command
content: Send a streaming protocol command to a thread over HTTP. This endpoint is the request/response companion to the SSE event stream and supports commands such as `run.start`, `input.respond`, `input.inje

title: AgentSchema
content: Defines the structure and properties of an agent.

title: StreamingChannel
content: A subscribable streaming channel. Namespaced custom channels use the `custom:*` form.

title: StreamingNamespace
content: Hierarchical path identifying a position in the agent tree. The empty array identifies the root agent.

title: EventStreamRequest
content: Request body for a connection-scoped SSE event stream.

title: StreamingCommand
content: Client-to-server command in the streaming protocol.

title: StreamingCommandResponse
content: Server response to a streaming protocol command.

title: StreamingEvent
content: Server-to-client event in the streaming protocol.

title: RunStatus
content: The status of the run. One of 'pending', 'error', 'success', 'timeout', 'interrupted'.

title: RunCreate
content: Payload for creating a run.

title: RunSearchRequest
content: Payload for listing runs.

title: ThreadSearchRequest
content: Payload for listing threads.

title: ThreadCheckpoint
content: Structured identifier for a thread checkpoint, ie. an entry in the thread's history.

title: ThreadCreate
content: Payload for creating a thread.

title: ThreadStatus
content: The status of the thread. One of 'idle', 'busy', 'interrupted', 'error'.

title: ThreadPatch
content: Payload for updating a thread.

title: StorePutRequest
content: Request to store or update an item.

title: StoreDeleteRequest
content: Request to delete an item.

title: StoreSearchRequest
content: Request to search for items

title: Item
content: Represents a single document or data entry in the graph's Store. Items are used to store cross-thread memories.
